First TBM reaches Pune for Swargate-Katraj underground Metro; tunnelling to begin in January

Work on the underground extension that will take the Pimpri Chinchwad-Swargate Metro corridor to Katraj is expected to begin in January.

The project needs four tunnel boring machines (TBMs), and the first of them has now reached Pune.

The machines will work about 28 metres below the ground surface.
